$comment: Structured finding codes. A finding is an expected workflow outcome, not a server error. blocking_scope names what the finding blocks: none (informational), record, feed_transformation, publication, transmission.

findings.explanation: The job has no bound import mode, scope, effective time, baseline version or field-update policy, or the feed is unrecognized.
findings.recovery: Bind an import intent explicitly or select an authorized feed profile. Until then the job runs in comparison-only mode.

findings.explanation: A full snapshot cannot establish completeness: parts are missing, declared counts disagree, parsing did not finish, keys conflict, or quarantine removed records needed for membership.
findings.recovery: Supply the missing parts or resolve the conflicts, then re-run. Diagnostics continue; no retirement is proposed from this snapshot.

findings.explanation: A zero-record full snapshot would empty its declared scope.
findings.recovery: Record an explicit, reviewed empty-scope decision or reject the snapshot.

findings.explanation: The baseline generation this analysis was computed against is no longer current.
findings.recovery: Recompute the comparison against the current generation and renew affected approvals.

findings.explanation: An import intent with this identity was already applied; the replay produced no second effect.
findings.recovery: None. Reanalyze under a different profile to create a separately identified analysis.

findings.explanation: The observed feed structure differs from the approved mapping contract in a way that changes field meaning: reordered positional columns, duplicate or renamed required headers, changed namespace URI, mandatory path, unit, date convention or schema version.
findings.recovery: Review the observed-versus-expected comparison and create a new profile version. Read-only inspection continues.

findings.explanation: Named columns were reordered but remain uniquely identified by approved header names.
findings.recovery: None. Identity-based mapping continues; the reorder is recorded.

findings.explanation: New optional fields allowed by the contract were found and preserved.
findings.recovery: None.

findings.explanation: A value or field discovered after sampling does not satisfy the selected contract, so completeness of the transformation cannot be claimed.
findings.recovery: Inspect the offending location; decide whether it is an isolated invalid record or a layout change.

findings.explanation: A message with the same revision key carries a different authoritative payload digest and the profile defines no amendment mechanism.
findings.recovery: Investigate the two payloads; keep both as evidence; do not apply either automatically.

findings.explanation: A message with the same revision key and matching payload digest was received again; the delivery was recorded and the business effect was not repeated.
findings.recovery: None.

findings.explanation: A change, replacement or cancellation references a predecessor that is missing or ambiguous.
findings.recovery: Hold the lifecycle effect; reconcile when the predecessor arrives or is identified.

findings.explanation: An older revision arrived after a newer one; history was retained without replacing the current version.
findings.recovery: None unless the profile's ordering rules say otherwise.

findings.explanation: The visit, movement, booking or time context cannot be resolved unambiguously: missing keys, ambiguous local time, or conflicting provider assertions.
findings.recovery: Retain an unresolved association for review; do not merge or overwrite.

findings.explanation: A proposed identifier correction would collide with an existing equipment identity or record.
findings.recovery: Review explicitly; do not merge identities by string similarity.

findings.explanation: An approval's change set, dependencies or evidence changed after approval.
findings.recovery: Show the new difference and obtain renewed review for the affected scope.

findings.explanation: One precondition of a linked edit group failed; none of the group's edits were published.
findings.recovery: Resolve the failed precondition and retry the whole group.

findings.explanation: Rows now matching a saved filter differ from the frozen selection manifest that was approved.
findings.recovery: Show additions, removals and stale rows; renew approval on the new manifest.

findings.explanation: Receiver feedback could not be correlated to any export attempt.
findings.recovery: Investigation queue; job acceptance state unchanged.

findings.explanation: Receiver feedback matches more than one export attempt or item.
findings.recovery: Investigation queue; manual correlation requires a recorded decision.

findings.explanation: The receiver returned a code or text the response profile does not define.
findings.recovery: Keep the original code and text visible and unresolved; do not infer success.

findings.explanation: A transmission attempt timed out or returned no usable status; the message may or may not have been received.
findings.recovery: Reconcile status with the receiver before any resend; no automatic retry where duplicate handling is unknown.

findings.explanation: An input or archive member exceeded a size, count, ratio or time budget and was not expanded or processed.
findings.recovery: Split or reduce the input, or process it through the private workspace's durable path.

findings.explanation: The input is a format the application does not parse (for example a Word document or PDF) and was not scanned as text.
findings.recovery: Convert or export the data from its source system in a supported format.

findings.explanation: The interchange or message envelope is not well formed: a message reference or segment count in the trailer disagrees with the body, a trailer is missing, or the interchange count is wrong.
findings.recovery: Obtain a corrected file from the sender. Identifier findings are still reported; nothing from the affected message is applied.

findings.explanation: A message lacks a segment or reference the bound profile requires, or uses a function the profile does not support, so its business meaning cannot be established.
findings.recovery: Review the message against the profile's implementation guide; extend the profile if the partner's variant is legitimate. The message stays staged and unapplied.

findings.explanation: Sender, receiver or message version differs from what the bound profile expects for this partner.
findings.recovery: Confirm the partner context; bind the profile that matches the sender, or record the new partner variant as a new profile version.

findings.explanation: No verified profile governs this feed: either none is bound, or the bound profile has not passed fixture, partner or production verification.
findings.recovery: Bind a profile and verify it against acceptance fixtures; partner and production verification are recorded by an administrator with evidence.
